The `--wait` compatibility regression should be fixed because existing invocations fail during the documented transition period.

## Changes
The pull request renames the parser option to `--timeout`, updates its tests, and adds a transition decision document. The default remains 30, and JSON and CSV remain available.

## Important
- app/cli.py:6 — correctness — Preserve `--wait` during the timeout transition — Passing `["--wait", "12"]` now exits with argparse error code 2. You register only `--timeout`, although `docs/adr/007-timeout.md:5` promises a one-release alias and deprecation warning. — Existing scripts using `--wait` fail immediately instead of continuing through the documented deprecation period. — Fix: Accept `--wait` as an alias, warn when it is used, and extend `test_explicit_options` to cover that invocation.
